from_speaker: the only place where generative AI can really make money

our_interpretation: The ordinary reading in this profitability-focused passage is that commercially substantial, sustainable profits from generative AI require selling software as a service.
The discussion emphasizes enterprise seats, but does not clearly exclude consumer software subscriptions from SaaS.
A counterexample must earn substantial profits from a generative-AI offering outside software subscriptions. Advertising, licensing or services could qualify if their profits are established.
General AI revenue, hardware sales and a diversified company's overall profits do not by themselves establish profits from a generative-AI offering.
Use April through June 2025, the latest completed calendar quarter that public reporting could cover before the post, because the sentence describes an ongoing state without naming a period.
criteria.support_condition: Broad, credible evidence establishes that commercially substantial generative-AI profits in the target period were confined to software-as-a-service businesses.
criteria.contradiction_condition: At least one documented, commercially substantial generative-AI business outside software subscriptions earned sustainable profits in the target period.
